adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/admin/components/embeddable-host.js.es6`, the `delete()` action calls `this.get('host').destroyRecord().then(...)` but has no `.catch(...)` (unlike `save()` which `.catch(popupAjaxError)`). If the DELETE request fails, the rejection is unhandled and no error is shown; additionally the row is only removed via `deleteHost` on success, so it remains with no user feedback on failure.
